subject: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts
messages:
From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@cloudhub.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@cloudhub.com>, procurement@cloudhub.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for sending the draft. A couple of quick clarifications from our side before we loop in legal:

- CloudHub wants explicit pass-through of marketplace transaction fees (we charge customers the cloud marketplace fee on top of list price). We need Redwood to agree that any per-transaction fees imposed by the marketplace (percentage or fixed) will be passed through to us instead of absorbed by Redwood.
- We have a standard escrow / suspension carveout when a marketplace requires settlement holdbacks — essentially we ask that Redwood not terminate for non-payment during a marketplace settlement window and that liability for those held funds is limited.

I've attached the vendor-side redline (very small). If Redwood's legal team prefers to handle this as an addendum to the Order Form rather than MSA language, that's fine.

Can you share the redline you saw and advise who on your side will own the legal conversation?

Best,
Michael
Head of Partnerships
CloudHub Partners

Attachments: CloudHub_MSA_Redline_Notes.txt (3 lines)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@cloudhub.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts

Michael —

Appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Laura (partner ops) and Monica (legal ops) — Monica will coordinate with Karthik from partner legal.

Two quick notes from our side:
1) Marketplace fee pass-through — we typically allow pass-through where the marketplace charges a distinct fee that we neither control nor receive. For multi-component billing we ask for a short definition clause so implementation teams can automate reconciliation.
2) Escrow/settlement holdbacks — our legal team is sensitive to any clause that prevents termination for non-payment; we can propose a limited non-termination window (e.g., 30 days) tied to documented marketplace settlement cycles and specify a damage cap tied to withheld funds.

I attached the internal redline Monica referenced; it marks up the Partner Paper and suggests an Order Form addendum for pass-through mechanics. Next steps: Monica to propose language and Karthik to confirm risk acceptance or fallback positions.

Action items:
- Monica: draft proposed addendum language by EOD Thu (22 Apr)
- Laura: confirm CloudHub's marketplace fee schedules and typical settlement lag
- Michael: confirm whether CloudHub wants the language in the MSA or Order Form addendum

Thanks —
Rachel
Senior Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudHub_Redline_MSA_20270421.pdf

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@cloudhub.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts

Michael / Rachel / team,

Quick legal note after reviewing the attachments. I proposed language intended to:

- Limit the pass-through to fees that are (i) imposed directly by the marketplace, and (ii) evidenced by an invoice or schedule; we will not allow an open-ended pass-through for any "marketplace-adjacent" costs.
- For escrow/settlement holdbacks, propose a 30-day cure window tied to marketplace settlement cycles and a liability cap equal to the specific funds actually held in escrow (no broader consequential liability).
- Add a mutual audit right for reconciliation on a quarterly cadence to prevent disputes about what was chargeable.

If CloudHub insists on a non-termination carveout longer than 30 days, we will need an explicit indemnity for losses stemming from marketplace misreporting, and Redwood will reserve the right to suspend service only after notice and failure to cure.

Draft language is in the attached PDF (redline). If you prefer, I can convert into an Order Form addendum table (clean copy + tracked redline).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Legal Operations — Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Partner_Paper_Comparative_Table.xlsx, CloudHub_Redline_MSA_20270421.pdf

From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@cloudhub.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Contracts Team <contracts@cloudhub.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts

Thanks Monica — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from CloudHub legal:

- The pass-through definition is acceptable provided we can automate the accounting via a known fee schedule per marketplace (we'll share a csv).
- Regarding terminations: we can accept a 30-day window if the holdback period is documented per-transaction and the cap equals the escrowed amount. We cannot provide an indemnity for marketplace misreporting — that sits with the marketplace.
- Can Redwood commit to a monthly reconciliation export (CSV) with transaction and fee line items? That is a hard requirement for our CFO.

If Redwood can do the export and accept the 30-day limited non-termination tied to documented holdbacks, CloudHub is comfortable with the Order Form addendum approach (keeps the MSA cleaner).

I'll attach the fee schedule once procurement confirms.

Best,
Michael

Attachments: (pending)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@cloudhub.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reseller addendum — clarification on fee pass-through & escrow carveouts

Michael —

Thanks, that's actionable. Summary of agreed positions (we will convert into redline + clean addendum):

- Pass-through: Redwood will permit pass-through for explicit marketplace-imposed fees when evidenced by the marketplace invoice/fee schedule. Language will include an automated reconciliation format (CSV) and quarterly audit right.
- Escrow/holdbacks: Non-termination window of up to 30 days tied to documented per-transaction holdbacks. Liability limited to the amount actually held; no open-ended indemnity.
- Reconciliation: Redwood will provide a monthly export containing transaction IDs, marketplace fee line items, and gross/net calculations. Engineering to confirm exact CSV field set; Ops to own delivery SLA.

Open items:
1) Karthik — confirm whether the monthly export triggers any additional privacy/data retention concerns (PII in line items).
2) Laura — expect CloudHub fee schedule expected by EOD Fri; please confirm and drop in the Drive link.

I'll prepare the Order Form addendum draft and circulate for CloudHub review by Mon (26 Apr). If CloudHub prefers changes to the MSA instead, tell us now — otherwise we'll treat this as an Order Form addendum.

Monica Patel
Legal Operations — Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_Draft_Outline.txt
